rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone who lacks artistic ability or talent.

example.english: They have always been terrible at drawing; they’re truly inartistic.
example.traditional: 佢由細到大都唔識畫畫，真係冇藝術細胞。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau4 sai3 dou3 daai6 dou1 m4 sik1 waa2 waa2 zan1 hai6 mou5 ngai6 seot6 sai3 baau1

rows.note: Use this for a work, design, or style that does not show an artistic feel.

example.english: The design of this poster is too slapdash and completely inartistic.
example.traditional: 呢張海報個設計太求其，完全冇藝術感。
example.jyutping: ne1 zoeng1 hoi2 bou3 go3 cit3 gai3 taai3 kau4 kei4 jyun4 cyun4 mou5 ngai6 seot6 gam2
